'''Cieryl Arjuna''' was [[Warder]] to [[Careane Fransi]]. It is unknown whether he was aware that Careane is [[Black Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
He was tall and gangly. He was short of his middle years and was all bones with wide shoulders.

== Activities ==
He [[Travel]]ed from [[Ebou Dar]] to the [[Kin]]s farm, where the group he was with had possession of the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

He then Traveled to [[Caemlyn]]. He felt Careane die inside the house on Full Moon Street and rushed inside to confront the Black Ajah [[Aes Sedai]] who killed her. It is assumed he died in the confrontation.
